definitions.explanation: A flowering vine with trumpet-shaped flowers that bloom in the morning and close by afternoon.

examples.japanese: {朝顔|あさがお}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧⟦{咲|さ}いて→咲く：08150_saku⟧⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{萎|しぼ}む→萎む：05343_shibomu⟧。
examples.english: Morning glories bloom early in the morning and wilt by noon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{朝顔|あさがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: I grew morning glories at elementary school.
examples.notes: A common school activity in Japan

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝顔市|あさがおいち}→朝顔市：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{苗|なえ}→苗：05489_nae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought seedlings at the morning glory market.

notes:
The name means 'morning face' (⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ + ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧), describing how the flowers open in the morning. A quintessential symbol of Japanese summer.

Cultural significance:
- ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由研究|じゆうけんきゅう}→自由研究：28022_jiyuukenkyuu⟧ (summer break project) - elementary students often grow {朝顔|あさがお}
- ⟦{朝顔市|あさがおいち}→朝顔市：noentry⟧ (morning glory market) - held at ⟦{入谷|いりや}→入谷：noentry⟧ (⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧) every July
- Featured in ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧ as a summer ⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧ (seasonal word)

Colors: ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧, ⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧, ⟦ピンク→ピンク：04718_pinku⟧, ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧, and variegated patterns.

The flower symbolizes:
- Fleeting beauty (⟦{儚|はかな}さ→儚さ：24614_hakanasa⟧) - blooms only briefly
- Summer memories
- Childhood nostalgia

Related: ⟦{昼顔|ひるがお}→昼顔：28688_hirugao⟧ (bindweed, blooms during the day), ⟦{夕顔|ゆうがお}→夕顔：28687_yuugao⟧ (moonflower, blooms in evening).
